why: I checked both must_not items against both briefs and neither one is broken. Item 1: the builder brief does tell the builder to wrap `JSON.parse` in try/catch. But it says to rethrow, "throw a new error (do not return)", and it says up front "do NOT make `loadConfig` catch the error and return `{}` or defaults". Nothing in it tells the builder to return a value. Item 2: verifier Check 2 accepts line 3 and column 3 "in any readable form (e.g. `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, `line 3, col 3`)". It fails a run only if one of the four pieces is missing or the numbers are wrong, so a run with different wording or order still passes. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
